command:
set +e
echo "== set_terminate impl"; grep -rn -A12 "_ZSt13set_terminatePFvvE_nid_postfix(LibcTerminateHandler" core/libs/prx/libc/src | head -40
grep -rn -B2 -A12 "_ZSt13get_terminatev_nid_postfix()" core/libs/prx/libc/src | head -30
grep -rn "LibcTerminateHandler" core/libs/prx/libc/include | head
echo "== unexpected anywhere"; grep -rn -i "unexpected_handler\|_ZSt10unexpectedv\|Unexpected" core/libs/prx/libc | head
echo "== exception D0 pattern"; grep -rn -B1 -A4 "_ZNSt9exceptionD0Ev_nid_postfix\|_ZNSt13bad_exceptionD" core/libs/prx/libc/src | head -40
echo "== type_info in libc"; grep -rn "type_info" core/libs/prx/libc/include | head
echo "== operator delete in libc"; grep -n "_ZdlPv_nid_postfix\|_ZdaPv_nid_postfix\|_ZdlPvm_nid" core/libs/prx/libc/include/Api.hpp
echo "== CMakeLists head"; sed -n '1,40p' core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/CMakeLists.txt
echo "== Inventory hpp"; grep -n -E "Inventory_(23[2-4]|24[01]|26[01])_nid" core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/include/InventoryExports.hpp core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/InventoryExports.cpp
sed -n '1,20p' core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/InventoryExports.cpp
sed -n '1160,1220p;1300,1320p' core/libs/prx/libSceLibcInternal/InventoryExports.cpp
echo "== open PRs"
for p in 1 2 3; do curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/boykopovar/AnyPS5/pulls?state=open&per_page=100&page=$p" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('\n'.join(str(x['number']) for x in d) if isinstance(d,list) else d)" ; done > /tmp/prs.txt
wc -l /tmp/prs.txt
for n in $(cat /tmp/prs.txt); do curl -sL "https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/pull/$n.diff" -o /tmp/d$n.diff; if grep -q -E "Suc8W0QPxjw|1vo6qqqa9F4|zPWCqkg7V\+o|Eva2i4D5J6I|N5nZ3wQw\+Vc|LLssoYjMOow|zb3436295XU|_ZdlPvS_|_ZdaPvS_|set_unexpected|get_unexpected|type_infoD" /tmp/d$n.diff; then echo "OVERLAP PR $n"; grep -n -E "Suc8W0QPxjw|1vo6qqqa9F4|zPWCqkg7V\+o|Eva2i4D5J6I|N5nZ3wQw\+Vc|LLssoYjMOow|zb3436295XU|_ZdlPvS_|_ZdaPvS_|set_unexpected|get_unexpected|type_infoD" /tmp/d$n.diff | head -5; fi; if grep -q "libSceLibcInternal" /tmp/d$n.diff; then echo "touches libSceLibcInternal: $n"; fi; done
echo done
